0022600182.text: The Nuggets host the Raptors with Denver at 3-3, 10th in the West and 2 games back in the Northwest, after a loss in their most recent game, while Toronto is 4-3 on a one-game winning streak, 4th in the East and 2.5 games back in the Atlantic. Denver is missing DeMar DeRozan (back spasms), Julian Strawther (knee sprain) and Spencer Jones (hamstring), and Toronto is without Kawhi Leonard (knee inflammation) and Nate Bittle (foot fracture). The Nuggets won the last meeting 121-115 in Denver on March 20, 2026, and swept the 2025-26 season series 2-0, with no games between the teams yet this season.
